result.summary: Found several layout and content issues on this food delivery app page, including a truncated restaurant card, an incomplete text label, and inconsistent heart icon styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen, with its name truncated abruptly.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards are properly indicated (e.g., partial visibility with a clear scroll affordance) or adjust spacing so text isn't awkwardly cut off mid-word.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outline style while the one on the pizza card below is a dark filled circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style and background across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The pizza promotional card at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar, showing only a partial image with no restaurant name or details visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll padding or card layout so users can see there is more content below, or add a subtle fade/indicator showing scrollable content.

issues.description: Category filter chips (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) appear cut off at the right edge of the screen, suggesting more categories exist but the scroll affordance isn't clearly indicated.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility cue to indicate the category list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Notification bell icon has a small red dot indicator but no visible count or label, which may not be accessible to screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add an aria-label or accessible text describing the number of unread notifications.
